name: Satisfying blackhead and pimple extraction videos
what_it_is: Macro, clinical-style clips of gloved practitioners squeezing, scraping and tweezer-extracting blackheads, whiteheads and sebum plugs from faces, noses and necks. Many are branded as "Trend Mahmoud Gamal" or Thai acne-extraction services, and a few add commentary or reaction framing, but all center on the same pore-cleaning procedure.
